meaning: Fresh official fullcatalog fetchedC13;only the five selected entries are stored here. Numeric authority remains locked workbooks,not an implicit later patch override.

tusk_tag_team.name: Tag Team
tusk_tag_team.description: Temporarily applies a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts 5 seconds.
tusk_tag_team.superUpgrade: Super: Increases bonus damage by 25 and duration by 5.
tusk_tag_team.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Increases radius by 400 and attacked units are stunned for 0.2s.

vengefulspirit_command_aura.name: Vengeance Aura
vengefulspirit_command_aura.description: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes.
vengefulspirit_command_aura.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Upon death, creates a strong illusion of the owner that deals and takes full damage and can cast all of their abilities (except passives that do not work on illusions). Illusion has 12% movement speed bonus.

custom_sven_warcry.name: Warcry
custom_sven_warcry.description: The hero's Warcry heartens their allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 9 seconds.
custom_sven_warcry.superUpgrade: Super: +10 bonus armor, +3s duration, +20% movement speed, and +400 radius.
custom_sven_warcry.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Warcry is now undispellable. Units affected by Warcry gain damage equal to 2x their armor (2x the effect on caster).

bristleback_warpath.name: Warpath
bristleback_warpath.description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
bristleback_warpath.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: +5 max stacks, and gains an extra Warpath stack per cast.

custom_bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
custom_bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
custom_bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.differences: Cast point removed. Increased cast range.
custom_bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.superUpgrade: Super: Becomes a no target area of effect ability, applying to all enemies within range. Increases Stack Limit to 7.
custom_bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Also applies to allies, gaining the reverse effect.
